mc: a person who acts as host at formal occasions (makes an introductory speech and introduces other speakers)
mcia: an agency of the United States Marine Corps that provides responsive and broad intelligence support for the worldwide Marine Corps organization
mccarthyism: unscrupulously accusing people of disloyalty (as by saying they were Communists)
mcguffin: (film) a plot element that catches the viewers' attention or drives the plot

mcintosh: early-ripening apple popular in the northeastern United States; primarily eaten raw but suitable for applesauce
